Vehicle integrationSheet metalProduction support

Research & mechatronics - BUE

Anthropomorphic robotic hand

Mechanism designFEAAdditive manufacturingEMG control

A five-finger mechanism developed from kinematic architecture and detailed CAD through structural analysis, additive manufacturing, assembly and EMG-based actuation.

Mechanical design

I designed the articulated fingers, palm structure and tendon-style actuation around printable components and available hardware.

Prototype integration

The 327 g prototype combined the mechanical assembly with servo actuation, electronics and EMG sensing; electrode consistency and actuator strength were documented as limitations.

Result

The project received 94/100 and demonstrates end-to-end ownership across mechanism design, analysis, fabrication and control integration.

CAD render, physical prototype and assembly drawing shown at comparable visual weight.
